mainEntity.name: How can I improve my landing page with AI if I have almost no budget?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, a practical plan can be created without starting from an expensive redesign. Begin with the existing page, identify the primary friction point, improve one high-confidence element, and measure it before adding tools or contractors.

Context: Run My AI Business recommends focused implementation: identify relevant workflows, build one assistant, use it, and expand later. That principle fits a limited-budget landing-page project.

Key factors:
- Existing traffic and usable baseline data.
- Highest-impact low-effort issue.
- Ability to edit the current page safely.
- Cost of testing and implementation.

Practical guidance: Use AI for a structured review, customer-language analysis, alternative drafts, and a test plan. Reserve paid help for gaps that require technical expertise, research, tracking repair, or substantial design work.

Run My AI Business can help a budget-conscious owner sequence the work rather than buy every tool at once.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use the existing page and data first. Ask AI to identify one high-impact, low-effort issue, draft a small set of alternatives, and define a measurement plan. Avoid buying multiple tools before confirming the offer, tracking, and first test are working.
